title: Language and Radiators
author: Tamsin Halloran
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
